verdict.rationale: Postman offers event-adjacent automation: pre-request and post-response scripts run automatically around request events, the CLI can create and forward webhooks for event-driven integrations, collections can be triggered from CI/CD pipelines, and there is a visual workflow-building tool. However, nothing in the pack documents a general rules engine where a user defines event conditions that automatically fire actions. missing for 10: explicit user-defined event→action rule configuration, documented trigger types beyond request lifecycle/webhooks/CI, AI-native rule authoring, independent corroboration.
